speaker: Merlin
text: 눈 떴어. …쓰러지던 순간, 네 영혼은 내가 붙잡았어.
text_en: You're awake. …The moment you fell, I caught your soul.

speaker: Merlin
text: 여긴 내가 만든 공간이야. 쓰러져도 넌 여기서 다시 깨어나.
text_en: This is a space I made. Even if you fall, you'll wake up here again.

speaker: Merlin
text: 그날 서임식에서 받은 무형검, 잃지 않았어. 다시 쥐여 줄게.
text_en: The Formless Blade you received at the knighting ceremony — it isn't lost. I'll put it back in your hand.

speaker: Shadow
text: …또 영혼 하나를 붙잡았군. 이번 건 얼마나 버틸까?
text_en: …So you've caught another soul. How long will this one last?

speaker: Merlin
text: 검만으론 부족해. 죽은 기사들의 힘이 깃든 유물도 하나 골라.
text_en: The blade alone isn't enough. Pick a relic too — it holds the power of fallen knights.

speaker: Merlin
text: 준비되면 성문 너머 심연으로 가자. 모르드레드도 거기 있어.
text_en: When you're ready, let's go through the gate into the Abyss. Mordred is down there too.

speaker: Merlin
text: 무기랑 유물부터 챙겨. 그래야 성문이 열려.
text_en: Grab a weapon and a relic first. That's what opens the gate.

speaker: Merlin
text: 다시 왔네. 유물도 무기도 늘 있던 자리에 있어.
text_en: You're back. Your relics and weapons are right where you left them.

speaker: Merlin
text: 기억해? 서임식이 끝나기도 전에 너는 쓰러졌어.
text_en: Remember? You fell before the knighting ceremony was even over.

speaker: Merlin
text: 그날 서임식에서 받은 무형검이야. 아직 형(모양)이 정해지지 않았어.
text_en: This is the Formless Blade from that ceremony. Its form hasn't been decided yet.

speaker: Merlin
text: 그래서 무엇이든 될 수 있어. 무한의 가능성이 깃든 검.
text_en: That's why it can become anything. A blade holding infinite possibility.

speaker: Merlin
text: 이번엔 이 검이 어떤 형이 될지 네가 정해.
text_en: This time, you decide what form it takes.

speaker: Merlin
text: 지금은 빛뿐인 검이야. 형은 심연의 재련소에서 골라.
text_en: Right now it's just a blade of light. Choose its form at the forge in the Abyss.

speaker: Shadow
text: 오래 묵은 기운이군. 이 방의 주인은 만만치 않아.
text_en: Old, heavy power. Whoever rules this room won't be easy.

speaker: Merlin
text: 물러서지 마. 쓰러져도 내가 다시 붙잡아 줄게.
text_en: Don't back down. Even if you fall, I'll catch you again.

speaker: Merlin
text: 해냈어. 잘 싸웠어.
text_en: You did it. Well fought.

speaker: Shadow
text: 끝까지 다녀왔군. 하지만 심연은 그보다 더 깊어.
text_en: So you made it all the way. But the Abyss goes deeper than that.

speaker: Merlin
text: 잠깐 쉬어. 유물도 너도 지쳤을 테니까.
text_en: Rest a moment. You and your relics must both be worn out.

speaker: Merlin
text: 정말로… 끝까지 갔네. 이렇게 빠를 줄은 몰랐어.
text_en: You really… made it to the end. I didn't think it'd be this fast.

speaker: Shadow
text: 처음으로 심연 바닥까지 갔군. …축하할 일은 아니야.
text_en: The bottom of the Abyss, for the first time. …Nothing to celebrate.

speaker: Merlin
text: 무슨 뜻이지.
text_en: What's that supposed to mean?

speaker: Shadow
text: 바닥을 보면 그 아래가 궁금해지지. 또 내려갈 거잖아?
text_en: Once you've seen the bottom, you start wondering what's below it. You'll go down again, won't you?

speaker: Merlin
text: 쓰러지지 않고 돌아왔어. …그게 얼마나 드문 일인지 알아?
text_en: You came back without falling. …Do you know how rare that is?

speaker: Merlin
text: 심연에 빼앗긴 유물의 기억, 하나씩 되찾고 있어.
text_en: You're winning back the relic memories the Abyss stole, one by one.

speaker: Merlin
text: 유물이 따뜻해. 네가 잘 써줬다는 뜻이야.
text_en: The relics feel warm. That means you used them well.

speaker: Merlin
text: 쓰러져도 넌 여기로 돌아와. 내가 널 붙잡고 있는 한.
text_en: Even if you fall, you'll come back here. As long as I'm holding on to you.

speaker: Merlin
text: 흩어진 네 영혼은 다시 엮어 뒀어. 넌 내려갈 채비만 해.
text_en: I've stitched your scattered soul back together. You just get ready to go down.

speaker: Shadow
text: …죽어도 끝이 아니군. 이제 이 심연을 쉽게 못 벗어날 거야.
text_en: …So death isn't the end. You won't escape this Abyss easily now.

speaker: Merlin
text: 네 영혼, 부서진 데 없어. 한 번 더 가자.
text_en: Your soul isn't broken anywhere. Let's go again.

speaker: Merlin
text: 널 쓰러뜨린 그 공격, 다음엔 먼저 보일 거야.
text_en: The attack that took you down — next time you'll see it coming.

speaker: Merlin
text: 숨 골라. 심연은 어디 안 가.
text_en: Catch your breath. The Abyss isn't going anywhere.

speaker: Merlin
text: 쓰러진 횟수는 내가 셀게. 넌 앞만 봐.
text_en: I'll count the falls. You just look ahead.

speaker: Merlin
text: 돌아왔네. 검부터 다시 쥐어.
text_en: You're back. Grab your blade first.

speaker: Merlin
text: 네가 쓰러질 때마다, 네 영혼을 더 단단히 붙잡을게.
text_en: Every time you fall, I'll hold your soul a little tighter.

speaker: Merlin
text: 실패가 아니야. 한 걸음 물러선 거지.
text_en: It's not a failure. You just took a step back.

speaker: Merlin
text: 네 싸움, 다 봤어. 마지막 순간까지 버티더라.
text_en: I watched your whole fight. You held on to the very last moment.

speaker: Merlin
text: 다시 채비해. 이번엔 조금 더 멀리 갈 수 있어.
text_en: Get ready again. This time you can make it a little further.

speaker: Shadow
text: 몇 번이고 돌아오는 영혼이라. …넌 누구의 도구일까?
text_en: A soul that keeps coming back, again and again. …Whose tool are you?

speaker: Merlin
text: 두려워도 돼. 대신 멈추지만 마.
text_en: It's fine to be scared. Just don't stop.

speaker: Merlin
text: 처음부터 다시야. 안 가 본 길로 가 보자.
text_en: Back to the start. Let's try a path we haven't taken.

speaker: Merlin
text: 손이 아직 떨리지 않네. 그럼 충분해.
text_en: Your hands aren't shaking yet. That's enough.

speaker: Merlin
text: 지쳤지. 알아. 나도… 이 반복이 편하지만은 않아.
text_en: You're tired. I know. This loop… isn't easy for me either.

speaker: Shadow
text: 왜 자꾸 돌아올까. …누가 널 이렇게까지 부르는 걸까?
text_en: Why do you keep coming back? …Who's calling you this hard?

speaker: Merlin
text: 가끔 모르겠어. 널 자꾸 되살리는 게 정말 널 구하는 길인지.
text_en: Sometimes I don't know. Whether bringing you back over and over is really saving you.

speaker: Shadow
text: 이쯤이면 눈치챘겠지. 이 반복, 우연이 아니야.
text_en: You must have noticed by now. This loop is no accident.

speaker: Merlin
text: 가자. 이번엔 내가 더 멀리까지 길을 살펴 줄게.
text_en: Let's go. This time I'll scout the path further ahead for you.

speaker: Merlin
text: 다섯 번째야. 넌 강해. 두 번 쓰러지고 무너진 영혼도 있었어.
text_en: That's five. You're strong. Some souls broke after falling just twice.

speaker: Shadow
text: 강한 게 아니라 이 반복을 못 벗어나는 거야. 끈질기긴 하군.
text_en: It's not strength. You just can't escape the loop. Stubborn, though.

speaker: Shadow
text: 열 번이라. 다른 영혼들은 대부분 이쯤에서 무너졌지. 난 봤어.
text_en: Ten, is it. Most other souls broke around here. I watched.

speaker: Merlin
text: 그래도 넌 여기 서 있어.
text_en: And yet, here you are.

speaker: Merlin
text: 스무 번. 이 반복이 어디서 끝날지, 나도 모르겠어.
text_en: Twenty. I don't know where this loop ends either.

speaker: Merlin
text: …그래도 너를 구하려고 불렀어. 그건 변하지 않아.
text_en: …But I called you here to save you. That won't change.

speaker: Merlin
text: 서른 번. 이 반복이 널 놓아주지 않으면, 우리가 끝내자.
text_en: Thirty. If this loop won't let you go, we'll end it ourselves.

speaker: Shadow
text: 쉰 번. …인정하지. 넌 실험체가 아니라 예외야.
text_en: Fifty. …I'll admit it. You're not a test subject. You're an exception.

speaker: Merlin
text: 예외?
text_en: An exception?

speaker: Shadow
text: 짜 둔 계획을 벗어난 영혼. 계획한 자는 이게 두렵겠지.
text_en: A soul that broke out of the plan. Whoever made that plan must be afraid of this.

speaker: Merlin
text: …작은 빛. 여기까지 온 건 내 힘만이 아니야. 네 힘이야.
text_en: …Little light. You didn't get this far on my power alone. It's yours.

speaker: Lich
text: 알고 있었다. 네가 올 것을.
text_en: I knew. I knew you would come.

speaker: Lich
text: 네 곁의 목소리, 멀린. 그의 기억과 마법이 내 안에 있다.
text_en: The voice at your side — Merlin. His memories and magic are inside me.

speaker: Lich
text: 나를 죽이면 — 멀린도 함께 사라진다.
text_en: Kill me — and Merlin vanishes with me.

speaker: Lich
text: 그래도 오겠다면… 받아라.
text_en: If you still come… then take this.

speaker: Lich
text: 멀린의 흉내는 여기까지다. 이것이 — 진짜 나다.
text_en: No more imitating Merlin. This — is my true self.

speaker: Lich
text: …이리 될 리가 없다.
text_en: …This cannot be.

speaker: Lich
text: 나는… 처음부터 누군가의 도구였던 건가.
text_en: Was I… someone's tool from the very beginning?

speaker: Merlin
text: …작은 빛.
text_en: …Little light.

speaker: Merlin
text: …고마워. 끝까지 와 줘서.
text_en: …Thank you. For coming all the way.

speaker: Shadow
text: 잘했어.
text_en: Well done.

speaker: Shadow
text: 네 영혼을 키우는 실험이 완벽하게 끝났으니까.
text_en: The experiment to grow your soul is complete. Perfectly.

speaker: Shadow
text: 너도. 멀린도. 저 리치도 — 전부 내 계획이었어.
text_en: You. Merlin. That Lich — all of it was my plan.

speaker: Merlin
text: 모르가나…
text_en: Morgana…

speaker: Merlin
text: 역시 그 그림자는 너였어.
text_en: So that shadow was you all along.

speaker: Merlin
text: 아직 끝난 게 아니야.
text_en: It's not over yet.

speaker: Merlin
text: …네 계획대로는 안 둬.
text_en: …I won't let it go your way.

speaker: Merlin
text: 무기가 손에 익었네. 이제 싸울 수 있어.
text_en: You've got the feel of your weapon. Now you can fight.

speaker: Shadow
text: …겉모습만 그럴듯하군. 심연은 칼날 따위로 무너지지 않아.
text_en: …Looks the part, at least. The Abyss won't fall to a mere blade.

speaker: Merlin
text: 채비는 끝났어. 힘이 될 서약은 문 너머 제단에서 맺어.
text_en: You're all set. Make a covenant for more power at the altar beyond the door.

speaker: Merlin
text: 서약서에 적은 조건(원인)이 일어날 때마다 적어 둔 효과가 발동해.
text_en: Each time the condition (the cause) written in a covenant happens, the effect written beside it triggers.

speaker: Shadow
text: 서약이라… 대가 없는 힘이 있을까?
text_en: A covenant… Is there such a thing as power without a price?

speaker: Merlin
text: 이제 정말 준비됐어. 앞의 문을 지나 깊이 들어가.
text_en: Now you're truly ready. Go through the door ahead and head deeper.

speaker: Shadow
text: …정예들이 덮쳐 오는군. 누가 풀어 놓았을까?
text_en: …Elites are closing in. Who let them loose?

speaker: Merlin
text: 제한 시간 안에 정예를 쓰러뜨려야 해. 몰아붙여!
text_en: You have to take down the elites before time runs out. Push hard!

speaker: Merlin
text: 습격을 막아 냈어. 역시 너야.
text_en: You held off the ambush. That's you, all right.

speaker: Shadow
text: …이번엔 운이 좋았군. 다음에도 그럴까?
text_en: …Lucky this time. Will you be next time?

speaker: Merlin
text: 황혼의 숲이야. 숲 끝의 수호자를 꺾으면 내가 봉인할게.
text_en: This is the Twilight Forest. Beat the Guardian at the forest's end, and I'll seal it.

speaker: Shadow
text: 숲이 왜 뒤틀렸는지는… 궁금하지 않아?
text_en: Don't you wonder… why the forest became so twisted?

speaker: Merlin
text: 서약 제단에서 서약을 맺으면 문이 열려. 나도 같이 가.
text_en: Make a covenant at the Covenant Altar and the door opens. I'm coming with you.

speaker: Merlin
text: 익숙해도 방심하지 마. 채비는 매번 새로 해.
text_en: Even if it feels familiar, don't let your guard down. Prepare fresh every time.

speaker: Merlin
text: 다시 왔네. 숨 고르고 필요한 것부터 챙겨.
text_en: You're back. Catch your breath and grab what you need first.

speaker: Shadow
text: 또 이 숲이군. 처음부터 다시 걷는 기분은 어때?
text_en: This forest again. How does it feel, walking it from the start once more?

speaker: Shadow
text: 용암 지대군. 숲은 넘었는데, 불 앞에선 어떨까?
text_en: Lava fields. You got past the forest, but how will you do against fire?

speaker: Merlin
text: 이 땅 끝엔 화룡이 있어. 여기서 단단히 준비해.
text_en: At the end of this land is the Fire Dragon. Prepare well here.

speaker: Merlin
text: 채비하고 가자. 너라면 버텨.
text_en: Get ready and let's go. You can take it.

speaker: Merlin
text: 다시 왔네. 장비부터 점검해.
text_en: You're back. Check your gear first.

speaker: Merlin
text: 신성한 성역이야. 네 서임식이 열렸던 곳인데… 무너졌어.
text_en: This is the Holy Sanctuary. Where your knighting ceremony was held… now in ruins.

speaker: Shadow
text: 그날 널 벤 모르드레드가 여기 있지. 이번엔 버틸 수 있겠어?
text_en: Mordred, who cut you down that day, is here. Think you can hold out this time?

speaker: Merlin
text: 숨 고르고 채비해. 여기서부턴 모르드레드의 기운이 짙어.
text_en: Catch your breath and get ready. From here on, Mordred's presence grows thick.

speaker: Merlin
text: 다시 섰네. 준비됐으면 망설이지 마.
text_en: You're on your feet again. If you're ready, don't hesitate.

speaker: Merlin
text: 천공의 대제단이야. 마지막으로 봉인할 리치가 저 위에 있어.
text_en: This is the Great Sky Altar. The last one to seal, the Lich, is up there.

speaker: Shadow
text: 그 리치가… 정말 봉인될 거라고 생각해?
text_en: That Lich… Do you really think it'll be sealed?

speaker: Merlin
text: 준비 끝내고 들어가자. 이번엔 다를 거야.
text_en: Finish preparing, then let's go in. This time will be different.

speaker: Lich
text: …멀린이 붙잡아 둔 영혼이 너로군.
text_en: …So you are the soul Merlin has been holding on to.

speaker: Lich
text: 또 너인가. 몇 번을 쓰러져도 다시 일어서는군.
text_en: You again. No matter how many times you fall, you rise once more.

speaker: Lich
text: 또 왔느냐. …그 끈기만은 인정하마.
text_en: Back again? …That persistence, at least, I acknowledge.

speaker: Lich
text: 질리지도 않는군. 이번에야말로 끝내주마.
text_en: Do you never tire? This time, I will end you.

speaker: Lich
text: …네 얼굴을 외울 지경이다. 다시, 시작하자.
text_en: …I am close to memorizing your face. Again, then. Let us begin.

speaker: Shadow
text: …나무들이 조용해졌군. 숲의 수호자가 가까이 있어.
text_en: …The trees have gone quiet. The Forest Guardian is close.

speaker: Merlin
text: 숨 고르고 가자. 수호자를 쓰러뜨리면 내가 봉인할게.
text_en: Catch your breath and let's go. Take down the Guardian, and I'll seal it.

speaker: Merlin
text: 이번에도 수호자를 쓰러뜨리고 봉인하자.
text_en: Let's take down the Guardian and seal it again.

speaker: Merlin
text: 망설이지 마. 저 수호자와는 이미 싸워 봤잖아.
text_en: Don't hesitate. You've already fought that Guardian before.

speaker: Shadow
text: 이 땅의 주인, 화룡이 깨어 있군. 뜨거운 환영이겠어.
text_en: The lord of this land, the Fire Dragon, is awake. Expect a warm welcome.

speaker: Merlin
text: 화룡의 불길도 이제 익숙하잖아. 가자.
text_en: You know the Fire Dragon's flames by now. Let's go.

speaker: Merlin
text: 모르드레드가 저 제단 위에 있어. 조심해, 작은 빛.
text_en: Mordred is up on that altar. Be careful, little light.

speaker: Merlin
text: 다시 모르드레드 앞이야. 같이 봉인하자.
text_en: Facing Mordred again. Let's seal him together.

speaker: Merlin
text: 마지막이야. 리치까지 봉인하면 다 끝나.
text_en: This is the last one. Seal the Lich, and it's all over.

speaker: Merlin
text: 리치를 쓰러뜨리면 봉인석 넷을 쳐서 깨워. 봉인은 내가 할게.
text_en: Once the Lich falls, strike the four seal stones to wake them. I'll do the sealing.

speaker: ForestGuardian
text: 침입자여. 이 숲은 더는 너를 들이지 않는다.
text_en: Intruder. This forest will no longer let you in.

speaker: ForestGuardian
text: 돌아왔는가. 숲은 네 발자국을 기억한다.
text_en: You have returned. The forest remembers your footsteps.

speaker: ForestGuardian
text: 몇 번을 베어도 숲은 다시 자란다. …너처럼.
text_en: Cut it down as you will, the forest grows back. …Just like you.

speaker: Dragon
text: 감히 내 둥지에 들어서느냐. 재로 돌려보내마.
text_en: You dare set foot in my nest? I will send you back as ash.

speaker: Dragon
text: 또 기어 왔군. 이번엔 뼈도 남기지 않겠다.
text_en: Crawled back again. This time, not even your bones will remain.

speaker: Dragon
text: 끈질긴 불씨로군. …태워주마, 몇 번이고.
text_en: A stubborn ember. …I will burn you, as many times as it takes.

speaker: DeathKnight
text: 고개를 들라, 그대여. 서임은 아직 끝나지 않았다.
text_en: Raise your head. Your knighting is not yet over.

speaker: DeathKnight
text: 다시 무릎 꿇으러 왔는가, 그대여.
text_en: Have you come to kneel once more?

speaker: DeathKnight
text: 몇 번이 오든, 이 검을 그대의 어깨에 내리치리라.
text_en: However many times you come, I will bring this blade down upon your shoulder.

speaker: Knight
text: 드디어 오늘이다. 원탁의 기사가 되는 날.
text_en: Today's finally the day. The day I become a Knight of the Round Table.

speaker: Knight
text: 원탁의 검을 받는다. …단 한 번뿐인 순간.
text_en: I'll receive the Round Table's sword. …A moment that comes only once.

speaker: Shadow
text: 그 검, 받지 않는 게 좋을 거야.
text_en: You'd be better off not taking that sword.

speaker: Knight
text: 누구냐.
text_en: Who's there?

speaker: Shadow
text: 돌아가. 오늘 이곳에서 끔찍한 일이 벌어질 거야.
text_en: Turn back. Something terrible will happen here today.

speaker: Mordred
text: 고개를 들라. 오늘 그대를 원탁의 기사로 임명하겠다.
text_en: Raise your head. Today I name you a Knight of the Round Table.

speaker: Mordred
text: 이 검은 아직 이름도 모습도 없다. 그대가 싸워 온 대로 모습을 갖출 것이다.
text_en: This blade has no name and no form yet. It will take shape by the way you fight.

speaker: Mordred
text: 받아라. 이제 그대의 검이다.
text_en: Take it. It is now your blade.

speaker: Lich
text: <color=#A855F7>멈춰라. 그 서임식은 여기서 끝이다.</color>
text_en: <color=#A855F7>Stop. This ceremony ends here.</color>

speaker: Lich
text: <color=#A855F7>오늘 원탁의 기사는 하나도 태어나지 않는다.</color>
text_en: <color=#A855F7>Not a single Knight of the Round Table will be born today.</color>

speaker: Lich
text: <color=#A855F7>검을 건네던 그 손으로, 이제 너를 베게 될 것이다.</color>
text_en: <color=#A855F7>The hand that offered you the blade will now cut you down.</color>

speaker: Mordred
text: 누구냐! 모습을 드러내라.
text_en: Who goes there! Show yourself.

speaker: Lich
text: 모르드레드, 원탁에서 가장 강한 기사여. 그 힘째로 내 꼭두각시가 되어라.
text_en: Mordred, strongest knight of the Round Table. Become my puppet — strength and all.

speaker: Mordred
text: <color=#9A6B6B>몸이… 내 뜻대로 움직이지 않는다…!</color>
text_en: <color=#9A6B6B>My body… it won't obey me…!</color>

speaker: Mordred
text: <color=#8B2020>도망쳐라, 견습 기사여! 어서!</color>
text_en: <color=#8B2020>Run, squire! Now!</color>

speaker: Mordred
text: <color=#E0453F>…서임을, 마치겠다.</color>
text_en: <color=#E0453F>…I will finish the knighting.</color>

speaker: Mordred
text: 그대에게 내릴 것은… 죽음이다.
text_en: What I bestow upon you… is death.

speaker: None
text: 아서왕의 시대. 원탁의 기사가 되려면 원탁이 내리는 검을 받아야 했다.
text_en: The age of King Arthur. To become a Knight of the Round Table, one had to receive the sword it bestowed.

speaker: None
text: 그 검은 원탁에서 가장 강한 기사, 모르드레드가 직접 건넨다.
text_en: That sword was handed over by the Round Table's strongest knight, Mordred himself.

speaker: None
text: 오늘, 한 견습 기사가 그 검을 받으러 간다.
text_en: Today, one squire goes to receive it.

speaker: Merlin
text: 이 아래 심연에 보스가 넷 있어. 지금은 쓰러뜨려도 끝낼 수는 없어.
text_en: There are four bosses down in the Abyss. Right now, beating them doesn't end them.

speaker: Merlin
text: 쓰러뜨리면 내가 봉인할게. 한 번도 안 쓰러지고 넷을 다 봉인하면 끝나.
text_en: When you beat one, I'll seal it. Seal all four without falling once, and it's over.

speaker: Shadow
text: 봉인이라. …그 봉인이 끝까지 버틸까?
text_en: A seal… Will that seal hold to the end?

speaker: Merlin
text: 숲의 수호자를 봉인했었어. 그런데 네가 쓰러지자 봉인도 다시 풀렸어.
text_en: We'd sealed the Forest Guardian. But when you fell, the seal broke too.

speaker: Merlin
text: 쓰러지지 않고 넷을 모두 봉인해야 해.
text_en: You have to seal all four without falling.

speaker: Merlin
text: 화룡도 사슬로 묶었었지. 너와 함께 그 사슬도 끊어졌어.
text_en: We'd bound the Fire Dragon in chains too. Those chains broke when you did.

speaker: Shadow
text: 묶어 두는 것만으론 모자라단 뜻이지.
text_en: Meaning binding it isn't enough.

speaker: Merlin
text: …모르드레드까지 봉인했었어. 네가 쓰러지자 그 봉인도 풀렸지만.
text_en: …We'd even sealed Mordred. But when you fell, that seal broke too.

speaker: Merlin
text: 마지막은 서임식을 망친 리치야. 모르드레드 너머, 가장 깊은 곳에 있어.
text_en: The last one is the Lich who ruined the knighting ceremony. Beyond Mordred, in the deepest place.

speaker: Merlin
text: …봉인이 전부 무너졌어. 리치가 내 봉인술을 쥐고 있었어.
text_en: …Every seal has collapsed. The Lich had my sealing magic in its grip.

speaker: Shadow
text: 돌아가라고 했지. 서임식 날, 아직 늦지 않았을 때.
text_en: I told you to turn back. On the day of the ceremony, while it wasn't too late.

speaker: Merlin
text: 이제 봉인은 안 통해. 보스는 쓰러뜨려도 한 번 더 일어나니까, 끝까지 쓰러뜨려.
text_en: Seals won't work anymore. Bosses get back up once after they fall, so keep at them until they're down for good.

speaker: Shadow
text: 걱정 마. 이 영혼은 이제 직접 끝낼 만큼 자랐어.
text_en: Don't worry. This soul has grown enough to finish them on its own.

speaker: Shadow
text: 같은 숲이 아니야. 여기선 회피에 스태미나가 더 들지.
text_en: It's not the same forest. Here, dodging costs more stamina.

speaker: Merlin
text: 한 번 넘어선 숲이야. 꿈속에서도 넘어가.
text_en: You've crossed this forest before. Cross it even in a nightmare.

speaker: Merlin
text: 여기선 회피에 스태미나가 더 들어. 아껴서 피해.
text_en: Dodging costs more stamina here. Use it carefully.

speaker: Shadow
text: 악몽의 불길이군. 여기선 보호막이 덜 차지(상한이 줄어).
text_en: Nightmare flames. Your shield fills less here (its cap is lower).

speaker: Merlin
text: 보호막에 기대지 마. 맞기 전에 먼저 쓰러뜨려.
text_en: Don't lean on your shield. Take them down before they hit you.

speaker: Merlin
text: 여기선 보호막이 얇아. 먼저 베어.
text_en: Your shield is thin here. Strike first.

speaker: Shadow
text: 새 서약을 맺을 수 없는 성소야. 가진 서약만으로 버틸까?
text_en: A sanctum where you can't make new covenants. Can you hold out with the ones you have?

speaker: Merlin
text: …쉬게 해 줬던 모르드레드가 악몽 속에서 다시 검을 들었어.
text_en: …Mordred, whom we laid to rest, has taken up his blade again in the nightmare.

speaker: Merlin
text: 새 서약은 못 맺어. 지금 쥔 것만 믿어.
text_en: You can't make new covenants. Trust only what you hold now.

speaker: Merlin
text: 리치가 아직 내 술식을 쥐고 있어. 여기선 E · R 스킬이 늦게 돌아와.
text_en: The Lich still has my magic in its grip. Here, your E and R skills recharge slower.

speaker: Shadow
text: 리치를 쓰러뜨렸던 제단이군. 악몽 속에서도 또 할 수 있을까?
text_en: The altar where you took down the Lich. Can you do it again, in a nightmare?

speaker: Shadow
text: 멀린이 남긴 술식이 너를 막는군. 우습지 않아?
text_en: Merlin's own magic is holding you back. Isn't that funny?

speaker: Merlin
text: 봉인이 풀린 숲이야. 수호자는 한 번으론 안 쓰러져.
text_en: The forest's seal is broken. The Guardian won't go down in one go.

speaker: Shadow
text: 이번엔 재울 수도 없겠네. 베어 넘을 수 있겠어?
text_en: No putting it to sleep this time. Can you cut your way past it?

speaker: Merlin
text: 봉인이 무너진 건 내 술식 탓이야. 길은 내가 열게.
text_en: The seals collapsed because of my magic. I'll open the way.

speaker: Shadow
text: 사슬이 녹았네. 이제 저 불은 누가 막지?
text_en: The chains have melted. Who's going to hold back that fire now?

speaker: Merlin
text: 봉인은 끝났어. 이번엔 화룡을 쓰러뜨리러 가자.
text_en: The sealing is over. This time, let's go take down the Fire Dragon.

speaker: Merlin
text: 화룡은 한 번 더 타올라. 힘을 아껴 둬.
text_en: The Fire Dragon flares up one more time. Save your strength.

speaker: Merlin
text: …봉인이 붙들던 검이 풀렸어. 모르드레드가 기다려.
text_en: …The blade the seal was holding back is free. Mordred is waiting.

speaker: Shadow
text: 봉인 없는 모르드레드야. 이번엔 이길 수 있겠어?
text_en: Mordred without a seal. Can you win this time?

speaker: Merlin
text: 이번엔 모르드레드를 쉬게 해 주자. 회색 검이 나와도 버텨.
text_en: This time, let's lay Mordred to rest. Hold on even when the grey blade comes out.

speaker: Shadow
text: 다시 저 제단이군. 리치를 죽이면… 누가 함께 사라질까?
text_en: That altar again. If you kill the Lich… who vanishes along with it?

speaker: Merlin
text: 누가 사라지든… 가자, 작은 빛.
text_en: Whoever vanishes… let's go, little light.

speaker: Merlin
text: 나도 이젠 망설이지 않아.
text_en: I won't hesitate anymore either.

speaker: Merlin
text: 하나. 숲의 수호자는 이제 다시 일어나지 않아.
text_en: One. The Forest Guardian won't rise again.

speaker: Merlin
text: 둘. 이제 화룡을 사슬로 묶어 둘 필요도 없어.
text_en: Two. No more need to keep the Fire Dragon in chains.

speaker: Merlin
text: 셋. 모르드레드의 검은 이제 아무도 겨누지 않아.
text_en: Three. Mordred's blade won't be pointed at anyone anymore.

speaker: Lich
text: 알고 있었다. 네가 올 것을.
text_en: I knew. I knew you would come.

speaker: Lich
text: 네 곁의 목소리, 멀린. 그의 기억과 마법이 내 안에 있다.
text_en: The voice at your side — Merlin. His memories and magic are inside me.

speaker: Lich
text: 멀린의 봉인술로 나를 묶으러 왔느냐. 그 술식은 나도 쓴다.
text_en: You came to bind me with Merlin's sealing magic? I wield that magic too.

speaker: Lich
text: 그래도 오겠다면… 받아라.
text_en: If you still come… then take this.

speaker: Lich
text: 이 사슬로 나를 가둘 수 있을 것 같으냐!
text_en: You think these chains can hold me?!

speaker: Merlin
text: 우리가 건 세 봉인이 리치를 묶고 있어!
text_en: The three seals we placed are binding the Lich!

speaker: Merlin
text: 지금이야! 봉인석 넷을 쳐서 깨워. 그 사슬로 리치를 묶어!
text_en: Now! Strike the four seal stones to wake them. Bind the Lich with their chains!

speaker: Merlin
text: 됐어… 이게 마지막 봉인이야.
text_en: Done… That's the last seal.

speaker: Lich
text: 멀린의 봉인술이라. …그 술식은 내 손에 있다.
text_en: Merlin's sealing magic. …That magic is in my hands.

speaker: Merlin
text: 안 돼… 봉인의 힘이 거꾸로 흘러!
text_en: No… The seal's power is flowing backward!

speaker: Lich
text: 봉인은 끝났다. 다음엔 — 네가 끝날 차례다.
text_en: The sealing is over. Next — it's your turn to end.

speaker: Shadow
text: 그 봉인이 버틸 줄 알았어?
text_en: Did you really think that seal would hold?

speaker: Lich
text: 네가 봉인한 것들이 모두 풀렸다. 밑바닥부터 다시 마주하라.
text_en: Everything you sealed has been set free. Face them again, from the very bottom.

speaker: Merlin
text: 봉인이… 하나씩 끊어지고 있어.
text_en: The seals… are breaking, one by one.

speaker: Merlin
text: 꽉 버텨! 곧 바닥이야!
text_en: Hold on tight! We're almost at the bottom!

speaker: Merlin
text: …살아 있어? 맨 처음 숲까지 떨어졌어. 다시 올라가자.
text_en: …Are you alive? We fell all the way back to the first forest. Let's climb back up.

speaker: Merlin
text: …살아 있어? 맨 처음 숲까지 떨어졌어.
text_en: …Are you alive? We fell all the way back to the first forest.

speaker: Merlin
text: 이 몸으론 다시 못 올라가. 거점으로 돌아가서 재정비하자.
text_en: We can't climb back up like this. Let's return to the base camp and regroup.

speaker: Shadow
text: 봉인이 풀린 놈들이야. 이번엔 제대로 준비하고 와.
text_en: Those are bosses with their seals broken. Come back properly prepared this time.

speaker: Lich
text: 사슬도, 봉인도 없다.
text_en: No chains. No seals.

speaker: Lich
text: 봉인으론 끝나지 않는다. 넌 나를 죽여야 한다.
text_en: Sealing will not end this. You must kill me.

speaker: Lich
text: 나를 죽이면, 내 안의 멀린도 함께 사라진다.
text_en: Kill me, and the Merlin within me vanishes too.

speaker: Lich
text: 알면서도 오겠느냐. …그렇다면 받아라.
text_en: You know this, and still you come? …Then take this.

speaker: Lich
text: 또 왔느냐. 몇 번을 와도 결말은 같다.
text_en: Back again? However many times you come, the ending is the same.

speaker: Lich
text: 사슬 없는 나를 몇 번이나 보는군.
text_en: How many times have you faced me without my chains now?

speaker: Lich
text: 제단이 또 무너지겠군. 너와 함께.
text_en: The altar will crumble again, it seems. Along with you.

speaker: Lich
text: …흥미롭군. 네가 이만큼 강해졌는가.
text_en: …Interesting. You have grown this strong?

speaker: Lich
text: 영혼이여. 남은 땅은 이 제단 가운데뿐이다.
text_en: Soul. The only ground left is the center of this altar.

speaker: Lich
text: 네가 쓰던 봉인술로, 이번엔 네 기술을 묶어 주마.
text_en: With the very sealing magic you used, I will bind your skills this time.

speaker: Lich
text: …작은 빛. 이쪽이야, 이리 와.
text_en: …Little light. This way, come here.

speaker: Merlin
text: 그건 내가 아니야! 도는 빛줄기 틈을 따라 같이 움직여!
text_en: That's not me! Move with the gaps between the spinning beams!

speaker: Lich
text: 최후의 마법이다. 이 제단째 날려 주마!
text_en: My final spell. I will blow away this whole altar!

speaker: Merlin
text: 청록 봉인석 넷을 세 번씩 쳐! 사슬로 끌어내리자!
text_en: Hit each of the four teal seal stones three times! Let's drag it down with the chains!

speaker: Lich
text: 또… 이 결말인가.
text_en: This… ending again?

speaker: Shadow
text: 잘했어.
text_en: Well done.

speaker: Shadow
text: 네 영혼을 키우는 실험이 완벽하게 끝났으니까.
text_en: The experiment to grow your soul is complete. Perfectly.

speaker: Shadow
text: 봉인은 처음부터 무너지게 만들었어. 쓰러뜨려야 네가 자라니까.
text_en: I made the seals to collapse from the start. You only grow by defeating them.

speaker: Shadow
text: 너도. 멀린도. 저 리치도 — 전부 내 계획이었어.
text_en: You. Merlin. That Lich — all of it was my plan.

speaker: Merlin
text: 모르가나…
text_en: Morgana…

speaker: Merlin
text: 역시 그 그림자는 너였어.
text_en: So that shadow was you all along.

speaker: Merlin
text: 아직 끝난 게 아니야.
text_en: It's not over yet.

speaker: Merlin
text: …네 계획대로는 안 둬.
text_en: …I won't let it go your way.

speaker: Merlin
text: …목소리가 흐려. 리치 안에 있던 내 반쪽이 사라졌나 봐.
text_en: …My voice is fading. The half of me inside the Lich must be gone.

speaker: Merlin
text: 그래도 네 영혼을 붙잡은 나는 아직 여기 있어.
text_en: But the me who caught your soul is still here.

speaker: Shadow
text: 감동적이네. 넌 이제 완성품이야. 더 깊은 심연으로 와.
text_en: How touching. You're a finished piece now. Come down to the deeper Abyss.

speaker: Merlin
text: 가지 말라곤 못 해. 가더라도 모르가나 뜻 말고 네 뜻으로 가.
text_en: I can't tell you not to go. But if you do, go by your own will, not Morgana's.

speaker: None
text: 랠릭페어리
text_en: RelicFairy

speaker: None
text: 봉인이 무너진 뒤
text_en: After the Seals Fell

speaker: None
text: 리치가 쓰러지며, 그 안에 갇힌 멀린의 반쪽도 스러졌다.
text_en: As the Lich fell, the half of Merlin trapped inside it faded away too.

speaker: None
text: 모르가나는 처음부터 봉인이 무너지도록 설계했다.
text_en: Morgana had designed the seals to collapse from the very beginning.

speaker: None
text: 작은 빛은 이제 — 제 발로 심연을 향한다.
text_en: Now the little light — walks toward the Abyss on its own.

speaker: None
text: 랠릭페어리
text_en: RelicFairy

speaker: None
text: 플레이해 주셔서 감사합니다
text_en: Thank you for playing

speaker: None
text: 여정은 심연으로 이어집니다.
text_en: The journey continues into the Abyss.

speaker: Lich
text: 일어나라, 제단 아래 묻힌 해골들이여!
text_en: Rise, skeletons buried beneath the altar!

speaker: Lich
text: 결계여 — 나를 감싸라.
text_en: Ward — enfold me.

speaker: Merlin
text: 결계야! 청록빛 해골을 쓰러뜨려!
text_en: A ward! Take down the teal skeletons!

speaker: Merlin
text: 결계가 깨졌어! 지금 리치를 쳐!
text_en: The ward's broken! Hit the Lich now!

speaker: Lich
text: 늦었군. 결계에 모은 힘을 받아라.
text_en: Too late. Take the power gathered in my ward.

speaker: Lich
text: 원소들이여 — 이 제단을 넷으로 갈라라.
text_en: Elements — split this altar into four.

speaker: Lich
text: 이 사슬… 끊어져라!
text_en: These chains… break!

speaker: Lich
text: 어둠의 비여 — 쏟아져라!
text_en: Rain of darkness — pour down!

speaker: Shadow
text: 이제 심연의 문에 들어갈 때 악몽을 고를 수 있어.
text_en: Now you can choose Nightmare when you enter the gate of the Abyss.

speaker: Shadow
text: 악몽은 챕터마다 불리한 규칙이 붙어. 대신 정수를 더 줘.
text_en: Nightmare adds a harsh rule to each chapter. In return, it gives more essence.

speaker: Merlin
text: …어느 길이든, 고르는 건 너야.
text_en: …Whichever path it is, the choice is yours.

speaker: Merlin
text: 봉인이 안 통해… 악몽 속 수호자가 다시 일어나!
text_en: The seal won't hold… The Guardian of the nightmare is rising again!

speaker: Merlin
text: 봉인이 안 통해… 악몽 속 화룡이 다시 타올라!
text_en: The seal won't hold… The Fire Dragon of the nightmare is flaring up again!

speaker: Merlin
text: 봉인이 안 통해… 모르드레드가 회색 검을 들고 일어났어!
text_en: The seal won't hold… Mordred has risen with the grey blade!

speaker: Merlin
text: 숨 돌렸으면 움직이자. 봉인할 보스가 아직 남았어.
text_en: If you've caught your breath, let's move. There are still bosses left to seal.

speaker: Merlin
text: 오래 머물 곳은 아니야. 가자.
text_en: This isn't a place to linger. Let's go.

speaker: Merlin
text: 손에 익은 것부터 챙겨. 처음보다 훨씬 빨라졌어.
text_en: Grab what feels right in your hand. You've gotten much faster than at the start.

speaker: Merlin
text: …네가 몇 번 깨어났는지, 전부 세고 있어.
text_en: …I'm counting every time you've woken up.

speaker: Merlin
text: 문은 같아도, 너는 매번 달라져.
text_en: The door is the same, but you change every time.

speaker: Merlin
text: …가끔 생각해. 너를 부르지 않았다면 어땠을지.
text_en: …Sometimes I wonder. What if I hadn't called you here.

speaker: Merlin
text: 왔어? 채비는 이제 네가 더 잘 알지.
text_en: Here? You know how to prepare better than I do by now.

speaker: Merlin
text: 가자. 말은 줄이고, 걸음은 늘리자.
text_en: Let's go. Fewer words, more steps.

speaker: Shadow
text: 깨어날 때마다 넌 심연에 더 가까워지는군. …재미있는 일이지.
text_en: Every time you wake, you get closer to the Abyss. …How amusing.

speaker: Merlin
text: 여기서 기다리는 건 나 하나야. 그거면 충분해.
text_en: I'm the only one waiting here. That's enough.

speaker: Merlin
text: 봉인은 무너졌어. 이제는 끝을 내러 가는 길이야.
text_en: The seals have collapsed. Now this is the road to ending it.

speaker: Merlin
text: 풀려난 것들이 기다려. 이번엔 쓰러뜨려.
text_en: What's been set free is waiting. This time, take them down.

speaker: Shadow
text: 봉인이 깨진 뒤로 눈빛이 달라졌군. …마음에 들어.
text_en: Your eyes changed after the seals broke. …I like it.

speaker: Merlin
text: 내 술식이 리치 손에 있어. 이 싸움은 내 몫이기도 해.
text_en: My magic is in the Lich's hands. This fight is mine too.

speaker: Shadow
text: 사슬로 묶던 시절이 그립지 않아? …아니겠지.
text_en: Don't you miss the days of binding them in chains? …I guess not.

speaker: Merlin
text: …네 뜻대로 가. 모르가나 말 말고.
text_en: …Go your own way. Not Morgana's.

speaker: Merlin
text: …내 목소리가 멀어지고 있어. 그래도 난 여기 있어.
text_en: …My voice is growing distant. But I'm still here.

speaker: Shadow
text: 멀린의 목소리, 아직 들려? 내겐 바람 소리 같은데.
text_en: Can you still hear Merlin's voice? To me it sounds like the wind.

speaker: Shadow
text: 설계는 끝났어. 이제 넌 어디까지 갈까?
text_en: The design is complete. Now, how far will you go?

speaker: Merlin
text: …끝이 아니라면, 끝까지 같이 가.
text_en: …If this isn't the end, let's go together to the end.

speaker: Merlin
text: 살아 나오는 게 몸에 뱄네. 그 감각, 잊지 마.
text_en: Coming back alive is second nature now. Don't forget that feeling.

speaker: Merlin
text: 처음 끝까지 갔을 때보다 숨이 고르네. 강해졌어.
text_en: Your breathing is steadier than the first time you reached the end. You've gotten stronger.

speaker: Merlin
text: 익숙해졌을 때가 제일 위험해. 긴장 풀지 마.
text_en: The moment it feels familiar is the most dangerous. Stay sharp.

speaker: Merlin
text: 또 끝까지 갔어. 매번 처음처럼 반가워.
text_en: You reached the end again. I'm as glad as the first time, every time.

speaker: Merlin
text: 돌아올 때마다 네 영혼의 빛이 조금 더 강해져.
text_en: Every time you come back, your soul's light grows a little stronger.

speaker: Merlin
text: 풀려난 보스들을 하나씩 끝내고 있어. 봉인으론 못 하던 일이야.
text_en: You're finishing off the freed bosses one by one. Something the seals never could.

speaker: Shadow
text: 풀려난 보스들을 다시 쓰러뜨렸군. 사슬보다 네 검이 낫네.
text_en: You took down the freed bosses again. Your blade beats chains.

speaker: Merlin
text: …잘 다녀왔어.
text_en: …Welcome back.

speaker: Merlin
text: …돌아왔네. 다음에 어디로 갈지도 네가 정해.
text_en: …You're back. Where we go next is your call too.

speaker: Shadow
text: 너 전에도 영혼들이 있었어. 다들 멀린한테 같은 위로를 들었지.
text_en: There were souls before you. They all heard the same comfort from Merlin.

speaker: Merlin
text: …미안해. 다 말해 주지 못했어.
text_en: …I'm sorry. I couldn't tell you everything.

speaker: Shadow
text: 죽고 돌아오는 이 반복, 누가 짰는지 궁금하지 않아?
text_en: This loop of dying and coming back — don't you wonder who built it?

speaker: Merlin
text: 오래 걸려도, 이 반복은 꼭 끝낼 거야.
text_en: However long it takes, I'll end this loop.

speaker: Merlin
text: 또 왔네. 어디까지 가 볼래?
text_en: Back again. How far do you want to go?

speaker: Merlin
text: 넘어진 만큼 길을 알게 됐어. 이번엔 그 길로 가.
text_en: Every fall taught you the way. Take that way this time.

speaker: Shadow
text: 멀린의 손이 언제까지 널 붙잡고 있을 수 있을까?
text_en: How long can Merlin's hand keep holding on to you?

speaker: Merlin
text: 말은 됐어. 가자.
text_en: Enough talk. Let's go.

speaker: Merlin
text: 몇 번을 돌아와도 눈빛이 같아. 그게 나를 버티게 해.
text_en: No matter how many times you come back, your eyes stay the same. That's what keeps me going.

speaker: Shadow
text: 스물다섯 번. …마법사 멀린이 부른 영혼치곤 오래도 버티는군.
text_en: Twenty-five times. …You've lasted a long time for a soul summoned by Merlin the mage.

speaker: Merlin
text: 내 이름을… 네가 어떻게 알아?
text_en: My name… How do you know it?

speaker: Merlin
text: 봉인 없이 맞서는 싸움이야. 쓰러져도 다시 가면 돼.
text_en: This is a fight without seals. Even if you fall, just go again.

speaker: Merlin
text: 봉인이 풀린 보스들은 더 거칠어. 첫 공격부터 조심해.
text_en: Bosses freed from their seals are fiercer. Watch out from the very first attack.

speaker: Merlin
text: 내 봉인으로 묶었던 보스들이야. 끝도 같이 내자.
text_en: These are bosses I bound with my seals. Let's finish them together.

speaker: Merlin
text: 점점 더 멀리 가서 쓰러지네. 나아가고 있는 거야.
text_en: You're falling further and further along. That means you're moving forward.

speaker: Merlin
text: 리치가 내 목소리로 불러도 따라가지 마. 그건 내가 아니야.
text_en: Even if the Lich calls you in my voice, don't follow. That's not me.

speaker: Shadow
text: 봉인이 무너진 게 누구 탓인지, 아직도 모르겠어?
text_en: Still don't know whose fault it is the seals collapsed?

speaker: Merlin
text: …돌아왔어. 내 목소리는 작아져도, 널 붙든 손은 그대로야.
text_en: …You're back. My voice may be getting smaller, but the hand holding you hasn't changed.

speaker: Shadow
text: 완성품이 넘어지는 것도 보기 나쁘지 않네. 다시 내려가.
text_en: Not a bad sight, a finished piece falling over. Go back down.

speaker: Merlin
text: …모르가나가 뭐라 하든, 넌 그녀의 것이 아니야.
text_en: …Whatever Morgana says, you don't belong to her.

speaker: Merlin
text: …쉬어 가도 돼. 나는 여기 있어.
text_en: …It's okay to rest. I'm here.

speaker: Shadow
text: 쓰러뜨린 보스들이 몇 번이고 다시 일어서지. 지겹지 않아?
text_en: The bosses you beat get back up again and again. Aren't you sick of it?

speaker: Merlin
text: 몇 번째인지는 내가 셀게. 너는 베기만 해.
text_en: I'll keep count of how many times. You just keep cutting.

speaker: Merlin
text: 뿌리 소리가 달라졌어. 숲도 너를 알아보는 거야.
text_en: The roots sound different. The forest recognizes you too.

speaker: Merlin
text: 몇 번이든 같이 가. 넷을 다 묶을 때까지.
text_en: However many times, let's go together. Until all four are bound.

speaker: Merlin
text: 숲이야. 가자.
text_en: The forest. Let's go.

speaker: Merlin
text: 질릴 법도 한데… 넌 늘 진지하네.
text_en: You'd think you'd be sick of it by now… but you're always serious.

speaker: Merlin
text: 열기에 익숙해졌다고 불이 약해진 건 아니야. 거리 지켜.
text_en: Being used to the heat doesn't make the fire weaker. Keep your distance.

speaker: Merlin
text: 불길 사이로 길이 보이지? 그 감각 그대로 가.
text_en: See the path between the flames? Go with that feeling.

speaker: Merlin
text: 여긴 한때 기도하던 성소였어. 지금은 적의 땅이야.
text_en: This used to be a sanctum where people prayed. Now it's enemy ground.

speaker: Merlin
text: 모르드레드가 아직 그 검을 쥐고 있다면… 내려놓게 하자.
text_en: If Mordred is still gripping that blade… let's make him put it down.

speaker: Merlin
text: 안개 너머에 리치가 있어. 내 기억을 쥔 채로.
text_en: Beyond the fog is the Lich. Still holding my memories.

speaker: Merlin
text: 또 마지막 싸움이야. 이번엔 리치를 봉인하자.
text_en: The final fight again. This time, let's seal the Lich.

speaker: Shadow
text: 남은 사슬로 수호자를 붙들 수 있을까?
text_en: Can the remaining chains hold the Guardian?

speaker: Merlin
text: 못 붙들어. 이번엔 봉인 말고 쓰러뜨려야 해.
text_en: They can't. This time we have to take it down, not seal it.

speaker: Merlin
text: 수호자는 쓰러져도 한 번 더 일어나. 대비해.
text_en: The Guardian gets back up once more after it falls. Be ready.

speaker: Shadow
text: 화룡이 제 불을 전부 되찾았어.
text_en: The Fire Dragon has regained all its fire.

speaker: Merlin
text: 화룡은 쓰러져도 한 번 더 일어나. 두 번째가 진짜야.
text_en: The Fire Dragon gets back up once more after it falls. The second time is the real fight.

speaker: Merlin
text: 또 화룡이야. 불이 꺼질 때까지 같이 버티자.
text_en: The Fire Dragon again. Let's hold out together until its fire goes out.

speaker: Merlin
text: …모르드레드. 이번엔 봉인이 아니라, 쉬게 해 주러 왔어.
text_en: …Mordred. This time we're not here to seal you, but to let you rest.

speaker: Merlin
text: 쓰러뜨려도 회색 검을 들고 다시 일어날 거야.
text_en: Even after he falls, he'll rise again with the grey blade.

speaker: Merlin
text: 회색 검을 들면 바닥 색이 뒤집혀. 마지막 색의 반대로 가!
text_en: When he takes up the grey blade, the floor colors flip. Go to the opposite of the last color!

speaker: Shadow
text: 이번엔 아무것도 리치를 묶지 못해. 끝까지 싸울 수 있겠어?
text_en: This time, nothing can bind the Lich. Can you fight to the very end?

speaker: Merlin
text: 리치는 내 마법으로 덤빌 거야. …이번엔 끝내자.
text_en: The Lich will come at us with my magic. …This time, let's end it.

speaker: Merlin
text: 리치가 내 목소리를 흉내 내도 따라가지 마.
text_en: Even if the Lich imitates my voice, don't follow it.

speaker: Shadow
text: 한 번 쓰러진 리치야. 심연은 그것도 다시 세워 놓지.
text_en: A Lich that already fell once. The Abyss stands even that back up.

speaker: Merlin
text: …몇 번이든 다시 쓰러뜨려.
text_en: …Take it down again, as many times as it takes.

speaker: Shadow
text: 네가 쓰러뜨린 수호자가 악몽 속에서 다시 일어났어.
text_en: The Guardian you defeated has risen again in the nightmare.

speaker: Shadow
text: 네가 끈 화룡의 불이 악몽 속에서 다시 타오르네.
text_en: The Fire Dragon's fire you put out is burning again in the nightmare.

speaker: Merlin
text: …악몽 속에서도 모르드레드의 검은 무거워.
text_en: …Even in the nightmare, Mordred's blade is heavy.

speaker: None
text: 검의 심판
text_en: Judgment of the Blade

speaker: Merlin
text: 떠 있는 검 중 그의 검과 같은 색을 베! 생긴 방패 안으로!
text_en: Cut the floating blade that matches the color of his! Get inside the shield it makes!

speaker: None
text: 무너지는 원탁
text_en: The Crumbling Round Table

speaker: Merlin
text: 붉게 차오르는 고리가 터져. 터진 고리로 옮겨!
text_en: The rings filling with red will burst. Move into a ring that's already burst!

speaker: None
text: 세 번의 십자
text_en: Three Crosses

speaker: Merlin
text: 네 자리에 십자 베기가 세 번 와. 대각선으로 피해!
text_en: A cross slash hits your spot three times. Dodge diagonally!

speaker: Shadow
text: 완성된 너를 시험하기엔 이 제단만 한 데가 없지.
text_en: There's no better place than this altar to test the finished you.

speaker: Merlin
text: …모르드레드. 이제야 검을 내려놓았어.
text_en: …Mordred. He's finally put down his blade.

speaker: Merlin
text: 지금이야… 봉인을 내릴게!
text_en: Now… I'll cast the seal!

speaker: Merlin
text: 뿌리까지 묶었어. …잠들어, 숲의 수호자.
text_en: Bound down to the roots. …Sleep, Forest Guardian.

speaker: Merlin
text: 봉인이 다 풀렸어. 이번엔 처음부터 온 힘으로 올 거야!
text_en: All the seals are broken. This time it'll come at full strength from the start!

speaker: Merlin
text: 지금이야… 다시 봉인할게!
text_en: Now… I'll seal it again!

speaker: Merlin
text: 사슬을 뿌리째 뜯어냈어… 봉인이 안 통해!
text_en: It tore the chains out by the roots… The seal won't hold!

speaker: Merlin
text: 이번엔 봉인이 아니라 끝이야. …편히 쉬어.
text_en: This time it's not a seal, it's the end. …Rest easy.

speaker: Merlin
text: 숲의 수호자가 조용해졌어.
text_en: The Forest Guardian has gone quiet.

speaker: ForestGuardian
text: 악몽 속의 숲은… 끝나지 않는다.
text_en: The forest of the nightmare… never ends.

speaker: Merlin
text: 수호자가 돌진한 길에 가시가 남아. 그 길은 밟지 마!
text_en: The Guardian leaves thorns along its charge path. Don't step on that path!

speaker: ForestGuardian
text: …뿌리가 다시 숨을 쉰다.
text_en: …The roots breathe again.

speaker: Merlin
text: 지금이야… 봉인을 내릴게!
text_en: Now… I'll cast the seal!

speaker: Merlin
text: 날개를 접어. …이제 잠들 시간이야.
text_en: Fold your wings. …It's time to sleep.

speaker: Merlin
text: 봉인 사슬을 녹여 버렸어. 이번엔 처음부터 날아올 거야!
text_en: It melted the sealing chains. This time it'll be flying from the start!

speaker: Merlin
text: 지금이야… 다시 봉인할게!
text_en: Now… I'll seal it again!

speaker: Merlin
text: 사슬이 녹아 버려… 봉인이 안 통해!
text_en: The chains are melting… The seal won't hold!

speaker: Merlin
text: 화룡의 불은 이번엔 다시 타오르지 않아.
text_en: This time, the Fire Dragon's fire won't flare up again.

speaker: Merlin
text: 화룡의 불씨 하나 남지 않았어.
text_en: Not a single ember of the Fire Dragon is left.

speaker: Dragon
text: 악몽 속에서도 내 불은 꺼지지 않는다.
text_en: Even in a nightmare, my fire does not go out.

speaker: Merlin
text: 화염구 비가 두 번 내려. 첫 비 뒤엔 옅은 칸을 피해!
text_en: The fireball rain falls twice. After the first, avoid the faint tiles!

speaker: Dragon
text: 드디어… 하늘이 내 것이다.
text_en: At last… the sky is mine.

speaker: Merlin
text: 지금이야… 봉인을 내릴게!
text_en: Now… I'll cast the seal!

speaker: Merlin
text: 검을 내려놔, 기사여. …이제 쉬게 하자.
text_en: Put down your blade, knight. …Let's let you rest now.

speaker: Merlin
text: 봉인이 다 풀렸어. 이번엔 처음부터 온 힘으로 벨 거야!
text_en: All the seals are broken. This time he'll swing at full strength from the start!

speaker: Merlin
text: 지금이야… 다시 봉인할게!
text_en: Now… I'll seal him again!

speaker: Merlin
text: 사슬을 검으로 베어 냈어… 봉인이 안 통해!
text_en: He cut through the chains with his blade… The seal won't hold!

speaker: Merlin
text: 모르드레드의 검이 멈췄어.
text_en: Mordred's blade has stopped.

speaker: DeathKnight
text: 악몽 속에서도… 내 기사의 맹세는 부서진 채다.
text_en: Even in the nightmare… my knight's oath remains broken.

speaker: Merlin
text: 금빛 환영 기수가 서면 모르드레드가 세져. 기수부터 베어!
text_en: When the golden phantom standard-bearer appears, Mordred gets stronger. Cut the standard-bearer first!

speaker: DeathKnight
text: 이 검을 막을 것은… 이제 없다.
text_en: Nothing… can stop this blade now.

speaker: Merlin
text: 이젠 네가 먼저 길을 알아. 나는 뒤를 볼게.
text_en: Now you know the way before I do. I'll watch your back.

speaker: Merlin
text: 숲이 길을 바꿔도 넌 금방 찾아. 그걸 믿고 가.
text_en: Even when the forest shifts its paths, you find the way fast. Trust that and go.

speaker: Merlin
text: 불길 앞에서 물러선 적 없잖아. 이번에도.
text_en: You've never backed away from the flames. Not this time either.

speaker: Merlin
text: 이 열기 속에서도 손이 안 떨리네. 가자.
text_en: Your hands don't shake, even in this heat. Let's go.

speaker: Shadow
text: 여기서 올린 기도, 누가 들었을 것 같아?
text_en: The prayers offered here — who do you think heard them?

speaker: Merlin
text: 성소의 길은 이제 네가 더 잘 알아.
text_en: You know the sanctum's paths better than I do now.

speaker: Merlin
text: 안개가 짙어지면 리치가 가까운 거야. 숨 고르고 가.
text_en: When the fog thickens, the Lich is near. Catch your breath and go.

speaker: Merlin
text: 마지막 문이 익숙해졌다는 건, 그만큼 멀리 왔다는 뜻이야.
text_en: If the final door feels familiar, it means you've come that far.

speaker: Merlin
text: 수호자는 두 번 일어서. 첫 번째에 다 쏟지 마.
text_en: The Guardian rises twice. Don't spend everything on the first.

speaker: Shadow
text: 풀려난 숲에서도 지치질 않는군. 누굴 닮은 걸까?
text_en: Still not tired, even in the freed forest. Who do you take after?

speaker: Merlin
text: 봉인이 풀려 숲이 더 사나워졌어. 그래도 길은 같아.
text_en: With its seal broken, the forest's gotten wilder. But the path is the same.

speaker: Merlin
text: 사슬 풀린 화룡은 하늘을 써. 위를 봐.
text_en: The unchained Fire Dragon uses the sky. Look up.

speaker: Merlin
text: 갈라진 검은 두 번 벤다. 두 번 피해.
text_en: The split blade cuts twice. Dodge twice.

speaker: Merlin
text: 이번엔 묶지 않아. 끝을 내러 가.
text_en: This time we don't bind it. We go to end it.

speaker: Shadow
text: 완성품이 뿌리에 걸려 넘어질까? 지켜볼게.
text_en: Will the finished piece trip over a root? I'll be watching.

speaker: Merlin
text: …악몽은 매번 달라. 끝까지 방심하지 마.
text_en: …The nightmare is different every time. Don't let your guard down until the end.

speaker: Merlin
text: 꿈이라도 아픈 건 진짜야. 조심해.
text_en: It may be a dream, but the pain is real. Be careful.

speaker: Merlin
text: …목소리가 닿는 데까진 같이 갈게.
text_en: …I'll go with you as far as my voice can reach.

speaker: Shadow
text: 새 서약 없이 싸우는 완성품이라. …그것도 보고 싶었어.
text_en: A finished piece fighting without new covenants. …I wanted to see that, too.

speaker: Merlin
text: 술식이 거꾸로 흘러서 스킬이 늦게 돌아와. 아껴 써.
text_en: My magic is flowing backward, so your skills recharge slower. Use them wisely.

speaker: Merlin
text: 보스들이 봉인에 눌렸던 힘까지 되찾았어. 얕보지 마.
text_en: The bosses have regained even the power the seals held down. Don't underestimate them.

speaker: Merlin
text: 다시 가자. 풀려난 보스들은 기다려 주지 않아.
text_en: Let's go again. The freed bosses won't wait for us.

speaker: Merlin
text: 보스들도 원래는 이렇게 날뛰던 게 아니었어. 편히 보내 주자.
text_en: The bosses didn't always rage like this. Let's let them rest in peace.

speaker: Merlin
text: …봉인이 무너진 건 내 탓이야. 그러니 끝까지 같이 가.
text_en: …The seals collapsed because of me. So let's go to the end together.

speaker: Shadow
text: 넘어져도 끝내러 가는군. 리치가 제일 싫어할 고집이야.
text_en: You fall, and still you go to finish it. The kind of stubbornness the Lich hates most.

speaker: Merlin
text: 한 층씩 다시 올라가자. 그 끝에서 리치가 기다려.
text_en: Let's climb back up, one floor at a time. The Lich waits at the top.

speaker: Merlin
text: 보스들은 사슬에 묶였었지만, 넌 네 뜻으로 싸워. 잊지 마.
text_en: The bosses were bound in chains, but you fight by your own will. Don't forget that.

speaker: Merlin
text: …다시 걸으면 돼. 천천히.
text_en: …You can just walk again. Slowly.

speaker: Merlin
text: …길은 내가 기억해 둘게. 넌 걷기만 해.
text_en: …I'll remember the way. You just walk.

speaker: Shadow
text: 널 완성한 내 앞에서 또 넘어지는군. 흥미로운 결함이야.
text_en: Falling again, right in front of me — the one who finished you. An interesting flaw.

speaker: Merlin
text: …내 말이 점점 짧아져도, 끝까지 너를 보고 있어.
text_en: …Even as my words get shorter, I'm watching you to the end.

speaker: Merlin
text: …얼마나 깊이 가든, 너를 놓진 않아.
text_en: …No matter how deep you go, I won't let go of you.

speaker: Merlin
text: …가자.
text_en: …Let's go.

speaker: Merlin
text: …리치를 쓰러뜨린 뒤에도 계속 가는 건, 네가 고른 길이야.
text_en: …Going on even after beating the Lich — that's the path you chose.

speaker: Merlin
text: 봉인 말고 끝을 내기로 했지. 몇 번이고 지킬 거야.
text_en: We decided to end it, not seal it. I'll keep to that, as many times as it takes.

speaker: Merlin
text: 봉인이 풀린 만큼 적도 세졌어. 너도 그만큼 강해졌고.
text_en: With the seals gone, the enemies got stronger. And so did you.

speaker: Merlin
text: 오늘은 몇이나 끝낼 수 있을까. 가자.
text_en: How many can we finish today? Let's go.

speaker: Merlin
text: 가자. 끝낼 상대가 아직 남았어.
text_en: Let's go. There are still ones left to finish.

speaker: Shadow
text: 아래가 부르는 소리, 너도 들리잖아.
text_en: You can hear it too — the call from down below.

speaker: Merlin
text: …내 힘은 약해졌어도, 넌 그만큼 강해졌어.
text_en: …My power has weakened, but you've grown that much stronger.

speaker: Merlin
text: …돌아올 곳은 여기야.
text_en: …This is where you come back to.

speaker: Merlin
text: …다녀와.
text_en: …See you soon.

speaker: Merlin
text: 풀려난 보스들이 하나씩 조용해져. 이게 맞는 길이야.
text_en: The freed bosses are going quiet, one by one. This is the right path.

speaker: Merlin
text: 내 봉인이 무너진 뒷수습을 네가 하고 있어. 잊지 않을게.
text_en: You're cleaning up after my collapsed seals. I won't forget that.

speaker: Merlin
text: 이젠 내가 걱정할 틈도 없네.
text_en: You don't even give me a chance to worry anymore.

speaker: Merlin
text: 또 끝냈어. 고마워.
text_en: Finished again. Thank you.

speaker: Shadow
text: 심연 바닥에서 돌아오는 길, 익숙하지? 그 아래가 더 있어.
text_en: The way back from the bottom of the Abyss feels familiar, doesn't it? There's more below.

speaker: Merlin
text: …무사해서 다행이야.
text_en: …I'm glad you're safe.

speaker: Shadow
text: 끝없는 심연을 산책하듯 다니는군. 내 작품 중 최고야.
text_en: Strolling through the endless Abyss like it's a walk. My finest work.

speaker: Merlin
text: …기다리고 있었어.
text_en: …I was waiting for you.

speaker: None
text: …정오의 해 아래서, 나는 지지 않았다.
text_en: …Under the noon sun, I did not lose.

speaker: None
text: 약속대로, 녹색 기사의 도끼 앞에 목을 내밀었다.
text_en: As promised, I bared my neck before the Green Knight's axe.

speaker: None
text: 아서왕께 서임을 받던 날, 해가 높이 떠 있었다.
text_en: On the day King Arthur knighted me, the sun hung high.

speaker: None
text: 내 아우들이 랜슬롯의 검에 쓰러졌다.
text_en: My brothers fell to Lancelot's blade.

speaker: None
text: 랜슬롯과 싸운 날, 정오가 지나자 내 힘도 기울었다.
text_en: The day I fought Lancelot, my strength waned once noon had passed.

speaker: None
text: 원탁의 기사들이 둘로 갈라져 서로 검을 겨눴다.
text_en: The Knights of the Round Table split in two and turned their blades on each other.

speaker: None
text: 랜슬롯을 용서하지 않겠다 했다. 죽기 직전까지는.
text_en: I swore I would never forgive Lancelot. Until the moment before my death.

speaker: None
text: 왕을 지키는 대신, 아우들의 복수에 매달렸다.
text_en: Instead of protecting the king, I clung to vengeance for my brothers.

speaker: None
text: 랜슬롯에게 입은 상처가 다시 터졌다. 그래도 싸웠다.
text_en: The wound Lancelot gave me reopened. Still, I fought.

speaker: None
text: 호수의 기사 랜슬롯. 그 이름에 부끄럽지 않으려 했다.
text_en: Lancelot, Knight of the Lake. I tried to be worthy of that name.

speaker: None
text: 내 검은 아서왕을 위해 뽑은 것이었다.
text_en: My blade was drawn for King Arthur.

speaker: None
text: 기사가 되던 날, 내 맹세는 왕을 향한 것 하나였다.
text_en: On the day I became a knight, my oath was to the king alone.

speaker: None
text: 왕비를 구하러 간 날, 원탁의 동료들을 베었다.
text_en: The day I went to save the queen, I cut down my comrades of the Round Table.

speaker: None
text: 모든 것을 가졌고, 모든 것을 잃었다.
text_en: I had everything, and I lost everything.

speaker: None
text: 미쳐서 숲을 헤매는 동안, 내 이름마저 잊었다.
text_en: While I wandered the forest in madness, I forgot even my own name.

speaker: None
text: 왕을 사랑했다. 그리고 왕을 배신했다.
text_en: I loved the king. And I betrayed the king.

speaker: None
text: 광기는 핑계였다. 무슨 짓을 하는지 알고 있었다.
text_en: Madness was an excuse. I knew what I was doing.

speaker: None
text: 내가 지킨다던 것은 결국 나 자신이었다.
text_en: What I claimed to protect was, in the end, only myself.

speaker: Merlin
text: 유물에 깃든 기사의 기억이야. 고른 기억은 이번 런 동안 유물을 강하게 해.
text_en: These are the memories of the knight within the relic. The memory you choose strengthens the relic for this run.

speaker: Merlin
text: 같은 꼬리표 기억을 모을수록 유물이 한 단계씩 세져. 이번 런 동안이야.
text_en: The more memories with the same tag you gather, the stronger the relic gets, one tier at a time. For this run.

speaker: Shadow
text: 기억이 하나 더 돌아왔군. 다 모이면 넌 뭐가 될까?
text_en: Another memory has returned. Once they're all gathered, what will you become?

speaker: Merlin
text: …아픈 기억이야. 그래도 놓지 마.
text_en: …It's a painful memory. But don't let go of it.

speaker: Merlin
text: 원탁이 무너질 걸 알았어. …막지는 못했지만.
text_en: I knew the Round Table would fall. …I just couldn't stop it.

speaker: Merlin
text: 아픈 기억도 같은 꼬리표끼리 모으면 유물이 한 단계 더 세져.
text_en: Painful memories count too — gather the same tag and the relic grows a tier stronger.

speaker: Merlin
text: 기사가 잊고 싶던 기억도, 이제 네 힘이야.
text_en: Even the memories the knight wanted to forget are your strength now.

speaker: Shadow
text: 기억이 쌓일수록 무겁지. 그 무게가 널 강하게 해.
text_en: The more memories pile up, the heavier they get. That weight makes you stronger.

speaker: Merlin
text: 그 기사도 이 기억을 지고 싸웠어. 너도 가져가.
text_en: That knight fought carrying this memory too. Take it with you.

speaker: Merlin
text: 첫 줄이면 충분해. 다음 챕터 제단에서 이어 쓸 수 있어.
text_en: One line is enough for now. You can keep writing at the next chapter's altar.

speaker: Merlin
text: 새 서약서야. 챕터마다 한 줄씩 이어 쓰면 돼.
text_en: A new covenant. Just add one line per chapter.

speaker: Shadow
text: 또 새 서약서군. 이번엔 몇 줄까지 쓸 셈이지?
text_en: Another new covenant. How many lines will you write this time?

speaker: Merlin
text: 앞 줄 효과가 발동하면 방금 이은 줄 효과도 이어서 발동해.
text_en: When the line before triggers, the line you just added triggers right after it.

speaker: Merlin
text: 한 줄 더 늘었어. 길수록 한 번에 터지는 효과가 많아져.
text_en: One more line. The longer it gets, the more effects go off at once.

speaker: Shadow
text: 쓴 만큼 너도 서약에 묶이는 거야. 알고 쓰는 거지?
text_en: The more you write, the more the covenant binds you too. You know that, right?

speaker: Merlin
text: 고쳐 써도 괜찮아. 서약은 네 싸움에 맞춰 바꾸는 거야.
text_en: It's fine to rewrite it. A covenant is meant to change to fit your fight.

speaker: Shadow
text: 지운다고 없던 일이 되진 않아.
text_en: Erasing it doesn't make it never have happened.

speaker: Merlin
text: 서약서가 가득 찼어. 이제부턴 고쳐 쓰기만 할 수 있어.
text_en: The covenant is full. From now on, you can only rewrite it.

speaker: Merlin
text: 서약서 끝 줄까지 한 번에 발동했어. 줄이 길수록 한 번에 받는 효과가 많아.
text_en: The whole covenant triggered, down to the last line. The longer the chain, the more effects you get at once.

speaker: Merlin
text: 끝 줄까지 이어졌어. 그 흐름, 끊지 마.
text_en: It chained all the way to the last line. Don't break that flow.

speaker: Mordred
text: <color=#E0453F>이 일격으로 끝내겠다. 원탁째 무너져라!</color>
text_en: <color=#E0453F>This strike ends it. Fall, Round Table and all!</color>

speaker: Mordred
text: <color=#E0453F>그대의 검은 아직 내게 닿지 않는다. 다시 일어선다면, 나를 찾아오라.</color>
text_en: <color=#E0453F>Your blade does not yet reach me. If you rise again, come and find me.</color>

speaker: Merlin
text: 기억의 제단 「여정」에 새 칸 3개가 열렸어 — 받는 피해 감소, 쓰러질 피해 한 번 버티기, 요정의 샘 회복 증가. 먼저 사 둬.
text_en: Three new slots opened on the Memory Altar's "Journey" — less damage taken, survive one fatal hit, and more healing from the Fairy Spring. Get them first.

speaker: Merlin
text: 가웨인의 해는 싸울 때만 돌아. 지금은 여명 — 적을 칠 때마다 태양흔이 쌓여.
text_en: Gawain's sun only turns while you fight. Right now it's Dawn — every hit on an enemy builds Sunmarks.

speaker: Merlin
text: 정오야! 쌓아 둔 태양흔이 한꺼번에 터지고 너도 세져. 지금 Q로 해를 떨어뜨려.
text_en: It's Noon! Your stored Sunmarks burst all at once and you get stronger. Drop the sun with Q now.

speaker: Merlin
text: 황혼엔 Q가 잠겨. 적을 쓰러뜨릴수록 다음 해가 빨리 떠.
text_en: At Dusk, Q is locked. The more enemies you defeat, the sooner the next sun rises.

speaker: Merlin
text: 칠수록 광기가 차올라 세지지만, 그만큼 아프게 맞아. 3초 안 치면 줄어.
text_en: Every hit fills your Madness and makes you stronger, but you take harder hits too. Stop hitting for 3 seconds and it drops.

speaker: Merlin
text: 광기 40 — 광란이야! 지금 Q로 심판을 내려.
text_en: Madness at 40 — Frenzy! Bring down Judgment with Q now.

speaker: Merlin
text: 광란이 끝나면 광기는 0부터 다시 쌓여.
text_en: When Frenzy ends, Madness builds up again from 0.

speaker: Merlin
text: 이제 보스를 쓰러뜨릴 때마다 유물 진화 카드가 나와. 한 번 고르면 런 끝까지 가.
text_en: From now on, each boss you defeat offers a relic evolution card. Once picked, it lasts until the end of the run.
